title: KĀLA-YANTRA v3 owner-surrogate decision, one line of run/DECISIONS_SURROGATE.jsonl (relaunch plan v2.7 §4a.3; .claude/agents/kalayantra-owner-surrogate.md, Record format)
description: One decision record of the owner surrogate on one awaiting item, in one of the states PROPOSED → EFFECTIVE → EXECUTED (routine classes) or PROPOSED → PENDING_VETO → EFFECTIVE → EXECUTED | VETOED | FAILED (veto classes). A veto-class record carries its veto_deadline and may be EFFECTIVE or EXECUTED only with an effective_at time (the veto controller, 'kyveto', publishes at expiry; nothing is published at proposal; a veto decision cannot have been executed without having become effective). A routine record carries no veto_deadline and is never PENDING_VETO or VETOED. A hard_stop record is owner-only: it stays PROPOSED and is never published as a delegated decision. Shape only: that 'awaiting' names an existing awaiting item, that the target is unchanged at expiry, that the authority binding is the active bundle's, that effective_at is not before veto_deadline, that the state history is a legal sequence, that the class is the charter's classification and that the notification was really submitted is not checked by this schema. veto_deadline and effective_at are UTC ISO-8601 ('Z' or '+00:00').

awaiting.description: The id of the awaiting item this decides.

target.description: The immutable parameters the decision applies to; contents are not typed here.

authority.description: The authorised source commit and the digest of the verified entrypoint binding the surrogate ruled under.

notification.description: The submission result of the owner notification; submission is never evidence that the owner read it.

reason.description: Optional: why the record is in its state (for example why it FAILED or was VETOED).

at.description: When the veto handler appended this transition line (UTC).

detail.description: Free-form detail the veto handler attaches to a transition (object or string).

allOf.$comment: veto class: a veto deadline, always.
veto class: EFFECTIVE only with an effective_at time.
routine class: no veto deadline, and never PENDING_VETO or VETOED.
hard_stop: owner-only; recorded as PROPOSED, never published.
veto class: the target is bound — a kind the veto handler knows how to recheck and the fingerprint computed at proposal (kyveto.py fingerprint).
veto class: EXECUTED only with the effective_at time it became effective at.
